customer_name.description: The organisation asking for the quote, with its legal form; a private person's name when no organisation asks

customer_tax_number.description: The customer's tax number, as printed

contact_name.description: The person who asks, or the named contact

contact_email.description: The contact's email address; otherwise the sender's address on the From line

contact_phone.description: The contact's phone number, as printed

deadline.description: The date by which the quote is wanted, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; a relative deadline counted from the request's own date

reference.description: The customer's own reference for the request (tender, project, RFQ number)

requested_items.description: Every item the customer asks a price for now, in the order written

description.description: The item as written, without its quantity

quantity.description: How many, as a number (written numbers too)

unit.description: The unit as the request gives it
